title: Lump-Sum Settlement Extensions: Allowance for a Recent Hardship Hold Decision
content:
# Lump-Sum Settlement — Hardship Allowance

A hardship decision recorded under Ridgeline's Hardship and Protective Holds on the account an accepted Lump-Sum Settlement covers bears on a due-date extension under its Settlement Agreements.

**Rule.** Where a hardship hold on the settled account was approved with a decision date after the same calendar day twelve months before the handling date, the Lump-Sum hardship allowance of 2 days is added to the grant; where a hardship hold request on that account was denied with a decision date in that same span, the Lump-Sum denied-request allowance of 1 day is added; an account with neither carries no Lump-Sum hardship allowance.

The span is the 12 months ending on the handling date; the hold's status and its decision date are read from the hold record on the settled account.

## Decision table

| Hold record on the settled account | Decision date after the same calendar day twelve months before the handling date | Allowance |
|---|---|---|
| hold approved | yes | 2 days |
| request denied | yes | 1 day |
| hold approved or request denied | no | none |
| no hold or request | — | none |

## Hypothetical dates

For a handling date on the 20th of a month, a decision dated the 20th of that month one year earlier is outside the span, and one dated the 21st is inside it.
